say:2:1536140501:1.text: Who else? He's the only winner of this year's Bloodhunt!
say:2:1536140501:1.source_cn: 还能是谁？猎血节的唯一胜者啊！
say:2:1536140501:1.male: Who else? He's the only winner of this year's Bloodhunt!
say:2:1536140501:1.female: Who else? He's the only winner of this year's Bloodhunt!

say:3:1536140502:1.text: They say the Bloodhunt is brutal, but this goes too far...
say:3:1536140502:1.source_cn: 说是猎血节很残酷，但这也太……
say:3:1536140502:1.male: They say the Bloodhunt is brutal, but this goes too far...
say:3:1536140502:1.female: They say the Bloodhunt is brutal, but this goes too far...

say:4:1536140503:1.text: What about the others? They're not all dead... are they?
say:4:1536140503:1.source_cn: 其他人呢？他们不会真的都死了吧？
say:4:1536140503:1.male: What about the others? They're not all dead... are they?
say:4:1536140503:1.female: What about the others? They're not all dead... are they?

say:5:1536140504:1.text: Should we go check it out ourselves?
say:5:1536140504:1.source_cn: 我们要不要找个机会去看看？

say:6:1536140505:1.text: Don't even think about it! No one knows what's out there. It's too dangerous!
say:6:1536140505:1.source_cn: 别！太危险了！谁知道那里有什么呀！
